overall.verdict: xln demonstrates extraordinary cryptographic transparency, state-machine determinism, and mathematical precision with its unified absolute-scale bar system and clear visual distinction between on-chain collateral and hub credit. However, its mobile UX is heavily laden with developer and protocol telemetry (unformatted 64-char hex IDs, raw millisecond latencies, 18-decimal token floats, and unanchored rate cards) that intimidates non-technical users and creates friction during rapid payments.
priority_fixes: Truncate and format all raw hex addresses and 18-decimal numbers across forms (Swap, Receive, Assets) with tap-to-inspect drawers.
Fix mobile scroll and viewport clipping by pinning primary action CTAs ('Pay', 'Execute Swap', 'Save Evidence') into elevated bottom action bars.
Humanize verification metrics on receipts and activity details (replace 'in 60832 ms' with '< 1s / 60s' and add clear receipt sharing / export).
Streamline multi-tier transfer/deposit selection in Move and Receive screens by replacing bulky 6-card grids with intuitive segmented source/dest switches.
Add proactive 'Collateralize' or 'Request Hub Collateral' action paths right where '$0.00 Enforceable' / 'At risk' warnings are shown so users can remediate exposure.
